items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: We even imported Guy Lafitte from Paris and did quite a few dates with Guy Lafitte

ctx.x: I know, right, right. You finished, you completed the tour, I understood that. You completed the tour, you arrive in Paris, you rehearse a new band. Then you go on a second tour around France.
Yes, because we even imported Guy Lafitte, you know probably Guy Lafitte -
